caption: The drawing depicts a puppet figure with exaggerated facial features, including wide eyes, a large red mouth with visible teeth, red circles on its cheeks, and a pointed red hat. The puppet wears a loose, full-body garment decorated with a floral pattern in shades of lavender, blue, and brown on a beige or light tan background. Its arms are extended outward, ending in oversized red mittens or boxing gloves. The legs are small and black, positioned at an angle. There is a visible seam along the side of the puppet's face and some string or thread at the shoulder. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and the artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Puppet
